note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 Package 2 affiliation evidence corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, operations, evidence, acceptance, or release.

domains.title: Club-affiliation application intake
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited central-registration intake obligations and Volume 12 evidence doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: Every intake binds an applicant, an organization, a jurisdiction, and a season.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs intake state, validation, and system of record.
domains.button_responsibility: Presents the intake experience and relays applicant input.
domains.external_system_responsibility: None at intake beyond identity assertion.
domains.prohibited_inference: Intake captured is not application complete is not application accepted.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the domain acceptance dossier and functional-evidence projection.

domains.title: Applicant identity and account establishment
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited identity and account governance and Volume 12 authorization doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: Identity is authenticated before authority is evaluated.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs account records, authority context, and audit.
domains.prohibited_inference: Authentication evidence is not authorization evidence.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the security-and-privacy acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Membership and roster context
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited membership governance and Volume 12 data-integrity doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: Roster context is scoped to the correct organization and season.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs membership and roster system of record.
domains.prohibited_inference: Roster shown is not roster authoritative is not roster accepted.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the data-and-financial acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Organizational and jurisdictional scoping
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited tenancy isolation invariants and Volume 12 authorization doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: No actor may cross an organization or jurisdiction boundary without authority.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs isolation, denial, and audit of scoped access.
domains.prohibited_inference: In-scope access shown is not cross-scope denial proven.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the security-and-privacy acceptance dossier with denial evidence.

domains.title: Authority, delegation, and assignment
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited authority-model governance and Volume 12 segregation doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: Delegation preserves accountability and segregation boundaries.
domains.affected_actors: Administrator, delegate, finance role, support role.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs authority grants, delegation, and audit.
domains.prohibited_inference: Delegation recorded is not delegation authorized is not delegation exercised.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the domain acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Fee determination and financial settlement
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited financial governance and Volume 12 reconciliation doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: A settled fee reconciles across applicant, provider, and accounting record.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs fee determination, financial record, and reconciliation.
domains.external_system_responsibility: Payment provider processes payment and acknowledges.
domains.prohibited_inference: Provider acknowledgement is not accounting confirmation is not reconciliation.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the data-and-financial acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Workflow state and lifecycle transition
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited governance-kernel lifecycle invariants and Volume 12 functional doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: Every transition is authorized, guarded, audited, and idempotent.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs lifecycle state, transitions, and audit through the kernel.
domains.button_responsibility: Requests transitions; never mutates governed state.
domains.required_evidence_classes: Functional, contract, event and webhook, audit.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the technical acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Bilingual and accessible applicant experience
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited accessibility and official-languages obligations and Volume 12 doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: The experience is equivalently available in English and French and to assistive technology.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs content, notification, and document obligations.
domains.prohibited_inference: English and French strings exist is not validated bilingual experience.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the accessibility-and-bilingual acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Affiliation activation and standing
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited activation governance and Volume 12 activation-standing doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: An approved affiliation is activated exactly once as a business invariant.
domains.prohibited_inference: Approval is not activation authorization is not activation execution is not active standing.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the domain acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Data integrity and reconciliation
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited data-integrity invariants and Volume 12 reconciliation doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: Tenant, parent, uniqueness, version, history, and provenance invariants hold under concurrency.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs the affiliation system of record and reconciliation.
domains.external_system_responsibility: External sources reconcile against the system of record.
domains.prohibited_inference: Schema exists is not database invariant proven.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the data-and-financial acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Migration of prior affiliation records
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited migration governance and Volume 12 migration doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: Migration preserves source authority, provenance, and recorded uncertainty.
domains.affected_actors: Data steward, migration authority, business owner.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs migration staging, quarantine, cutover, and acceptance.
domains.external_system_responsibility: Legacy sources provide records under recorded provenance.
domains.prohibited_inference: Migration executed is not migration accepted is not source retired.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the migration acceptance dossier.

domains.title: Operational support, continuity, training, and adoption
domains.authoritative_requirement: Inherited operational and adoption governance and Volume 12 operational doctrine.
domains.institutional_invariant: Operability, recovery, competence, and sustained adoption are separately evidenced.
domains.affected_actors: Support role, operator, trainer, operating community.
domains.house_responsibility: Governs operational, continuity, training, and adoption obligations.
domains.external_system_responsibility: Providers meet operational and exit obligations.
domains.required_evidence_classes: Operational, recovery, provider, training and competence, adoption.
domains.prohibited_inference: Training delivered is not competence demonstrated.
domains.governed_documentary_disposition: Routed to the operational and training-and-adoption acceptance dossiers.
